purpose: Collect bounded evidence for VDD, VCM, load condition, and source/ADE-state semantic revision linkage without simulation, design mutation, or raw design disclosure.

role_binding_precondition.reason: Existing bounded evidence does not identify exact OA instances, nets, terminals, and properties representing VDD, VCM, or load.

required_immutable_manifest.load_selectors: ordered fixed list of exact instance/net/terminal/property tuples
required_immutable_manifest.expected_cardinality: exactly one VDD, exactly one VCM, and an explicit bounded load count

allowed_sources: separately approved fixed names-only role discovery

load.elements: array of at most 8 bounded kind/value/unit objects

sensitive_output_denylist: instance, net, terminal, or property names
fail_closed_conditions: any argument or caller-supplied design value
installation identity or runner version outside the reviewed contract
missing, symlinked, unreadable, oversized, or non-regular fixed input
active, stale, ambiguous, panic, or recovery blocking artifact
role selector mismatch or unexpected cardinality
unsupported expression, unit, master cell, or property type
source, state, profile, source snapshot, model, or binding fingerprint change
OA open mode other than r or close failure
timeout, concurrent invocation, oversized output, or unbounded error
any attempted simulation, save, write, deployment, or MCP exposure
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: plan v1 and decision record v4 hashes are verified before any future implementation
AC-02: the command accepts zero arguments and is operator-only, absent from the MCP surface
AC-03: the exact profile, source cellview, ADE state, state files, source snapshot, and model hash target are compiled into reviewed code
AC-04: an immutable exact role-binding manifest is reviewed and hash-bound before implementation; no instance, net, terminal, or property selector is guessed
AC-05: no arbitrary shell, SKILL, path, design identifier, property name, value, or expression input exists
AC-06: source OA is opened only with mode r and is closed without save on success and failure paths
AC-07: all fixed files and trees satisfy symlink, type, readability, entry-count, and byte-size limits
AC-08: source, state, profile, source snapshot, PDK model, and binding fingerprints are captured before and after and all are unchanged
AC-09: active or ambiguous locks and panic/recovery artifacts cause BLOCKED without deletion, unlock, rename, or retry
AC-10: VDD and VCM are emitted only for one exact bound selector each; absent, ambiguous, unsupported, or out-of-range evidence emits null and a blocker
AC-11: load output contains at most eight exact bound elements with finite values and allowlisted kinds and units; ambiguity emits no guessed aggregate
AC-12: ADE-state bias values remain separately identified and are tied to the exact state fingerprint from the same observation
AC-13: source/state semantic equivalence requires an explicit hash or embedded revision binding; identity, topology, hashes, or timestamps alone never establish equivalence
AC-14: output validates against the fixed schema, is at most 32768 bytes, and contains no raw content, paths, object names, PDK content, licenses, credentials, or unbounded errors
AC-15: total execution ends within 90 seconds, OA open/close within 30 seconds, and nonblocking concurrency remains exactly one
AC-16: simulation, netlisting, result extraction, profile mutation, OA save, ADE-state write, design/PDK/work-library write, deployment, and MCP changes are absent

AC-17: negative tests cover arguments, injection, Unicode/confusable identifiers, symlinks, oversized inputs, duplicate roles, unsupported expressions, lock states, fingerprint drift, timeout, and redaction
AC-18: actual execution requires separate approvals for the reviewed role binding, implementation/deployment, and one fixed read-only invocation
AC-19: collector success records evidence only and never confirms the scientific baseline; final approval or rejection remains a separate user decision
AC-20: failure performs no cleanup, unlock, automatic retry, fallback target, simulation, mutation, merge, or WP-15 work
next_gate: User reviews this plan and either supplies an exact immutable role-binding manifest or separately approves a fixed names-only role-discovery plan. No implementation, deployment, or execution is authorized by plan approval alone.
